examples.arabic: هي اشترت قميص لونه زهري للرحلة الطويلة
examples.english: She bought a pink shirt for the long trip
examples.transliteration: Hiya ishtarat qamis lawnuhu zahri lil rihla al tawila

examples.arabic: دفع أحمد ثمن القميص وشكر البائع على مساعدته
examples.english: Ahmad paid the price of the shirt and thanked the seller for his help.
examples.transliteration: dafaa ahmad thaman al qamis wa shakara al baia ala musadatihi

examples.english: She went to the shop to return the shirt.

examples.arabic: احمد ووالده ذهبا الى المتجر مساء لارجاع قميص جديد
examples.english: Ahmed and his father went to the shop in the evening to return a new shirt.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad wa waaliduhu dhahaba ila al-matjari masaa'an li-irjaa'i qameesin jadeedin.
examples.storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning to the Shop

examples.arabic: في قسم الملابس رأت الجدة قميصا وسألت حفيدتها هل يعجبك هذا القميص
examples.english: In the clothing section, the grandmother saw a shirt and asked her granddaughter, "Do you like this shirt?"
examples.transliteration: Fī qismi al-malābisī raʾat al-jaddatu qamīṣan wa-saʾalat ḥafīdatahā hal yuʿjibuki hādhā al-qamīṣu.
